title: Page 3
content_zh:
「璎珞，真的很高兴你能来玄武城一趟。」上官悦落坐在苏坤源身旁，感激她为了促成二人之事而走上这一趟。

「你们两个之后有何打算？」她想先听听两人接下来打算怎么做。

「我原本就打算等爹的寿辰过后，再来提我和悦儿之间的事。爹娘一直很喜欢你，所以我想由你出面直接拒绝我，我想爹娘这才会死心。」如果两人对彼此都没有感情，长辈们再喜欢也没有用，总不能押着两人拜堂吧。

「好。我会找个时间向珠姨开口的。」裴璎珞一口答应。这事简单，杏眸瞧向上官悦。「悦儿，你爹娘应该不会反对你和苏大哥之事的事吧？」

「你也知道我们母女在府里根本没有什么地位，对于能攀上苏家，爹自然是高兴。」上官悦苦涩一笑。

苏坤源安慰地轻握住她的手，两人之间自然流露出的情意，令坐在对座的裴璎珞欣羡不已。

三人间聊了会，裴璎珞识趣地先行离开，让二人独处。

裴璎珞主仆二人离开客栈，向人问了灵凤轩的方向后，约莫走了一刻钟。

此刻，她站在城东的灵凤轩铺子前，望着悬挂在大门上的牌匾，黑底金字写着灵凤轩三个大字。

「姑娘，是否要进来参观？我们灵凤轩卖的水晶，可都是难得一见的珍品。」身着青袍、娃娃脸上堆满笑意的常青见着门外站着令人惊艳的灵秀佳人，主动走上前询问。

「那就劳烦你了。」裴璎珞柔美的脸上漾起一抹浅笑。

那抹浅笑令常青一时看直了眼，还是一旁的秋月不悦地轻咳了声，他这才回过神来，恭敬有礼地领着主仆进入铺子里。

裴璎珞一踏进铺子里，瞧着陈列在柜子上的项链、手链、耳坠、摆设，全是用各色水晶做成的，颗颗色泽光彩夺目，一看即知质地胜过珠玉阁。

裴家自个儿拥有金矿脉、银矿脉，提供珠玉阁的金、银饰品自是没有问题。

但若论起水晶，则是由大哥的一位专走南北货的朋友所提供，自是无法与灵山岛所开采出来的水晶相提并论。

这也是大哥希望她能和慕容彻见上一面，谈谈两家合作的可能。这是她来玄武城的第二个目的。

只不过她万万没有想到慕容彻会是那样一个笑里藏刀之人，因此对于大哥所提出的合作可能，她……犹豫了。

「不知灵凤轩所卖的水晶饰品是否能入裴二小姐的眼？」

蓦地，身后传来一道带笑的嗓音，裴璎珞惊愕地旋身，杏眸对上那张清俊含笑的俊颜。

「慕容公子。」既然在这遇上了他，何不趁此机会和他谈谈？

「素闻珠玉阁的发饰全由裴二小姐亲手绘制图稿才去雕琢，就不知二小姐对灵凤轩所卖的水晶有何看法？」慕容彻黑眸含笑，没错过她方才旋身面对他那一刹那黛眉轻蹙的微小动作，看来她并不高兴见着他。

「慕容公子客气了。灵凤轩里的每件水晶质地清透，颜色鲜艳，实属上品。不论是紫晶项链、粉晶手链、黄晶坠饰……等，各个饰品都令人惊艳，璎珞又哪敢有何看法呢。」她说这些话并非客套，而是实话。

之前只听闻灵凤轩的水晶质地上等，百闻不如一见，也难怪即使价格不菲，仍是令众人趋之若鹜。

据闻宫里的娘娘们独爱灵凤轩的水晶饰品，皇后姨娘那更有一条十分宝贝的紫晶项链。

「能得到裴二小姐的称赞，可是我灵凤轩莫大的荣幸。」

慕容彻黑眸注视着她柔美的娇颜，曾听闻裴家三姊妹拥有倾城美貌，原本认为传闻过于夸大，直到他在孟府见过裴琉璃，如今又见到裴璎珞，这才相信传闻属实。

不同于裴琉璃绝美容颜下透着精明，裴璎珞的柔美透着一股灵秀恬静，看得出性情该是不错。

「慕容公子此刻不知是否有空，璎珞有件事想私下和公子谈谈。」

慕容彻讶异地挑眉，清俊脸上的笑容更深了。

「那就请随我来吧。」率先往铺子里头角落的布帘方向而去。

裴璎珞见状赶紧跟上，见他掀开布帘一路往内直走，经过穿堂，来到一间厢房前停下脚步。

慕容彻回头朝她含笑望去，推开门走了进去。

裴璎珞犹豫了会，正欲跟着走进去，却被秋月一把拉住。

「二小姐，你确定要进去吗？那个慕容公子虽然始终一张笑容，可感觉得出并不是个好人。」秋月只要想到在朱雀城胡同见到的那一幕，就忍不住害怕：她相信二小姐应该也很难忘记。

「他虽非好人，但应还不至于会做出伤害我的事。别忘了，我们此番前来，还有大哥交代的事要完成。」裴璎珞相信自个儿不会看错人的。

秋月一听，便不再阻止。大少爷交代二小姐的事，她当时也在场。

「走吧。」

裴璎珞瞥了她一眼，率先走了进去，秋月连忙随后跟上。

第2章(1)

「我不答应。」

慕容彻笑望着对座的柔美佳人，轻啜了口热茶，毫不考虑地一口拒绝她的提议。

「慕容公子，家兄很有诚意想要与灵凤轩合作，价钱的事好谈。」裴璎珞软言再劝。

心底暗忖自己并不擅长生意上的事，大哥却要她出面谈成这桩合作的事，实在是难为了她。更何况她面对的这个男人并不简单，她怎么可能说服得了他呢？

两人此刻所待的厢房是慕容彻来灵凤轩时休憩的厢房，为了避嫌，房门大敞，她身后还跟着不放心她的秋月。

「灵凤轩里所卖的水晶，我并不打算与人分享利润，是由灵凤轩所独卖的。你们裴家珠玉阁已在朝野享有盛名，又何必贪心地觊觎灵凤轩的水晶呢？」慕容彻替她倒了杯热茶，含笑语气里夹带着浓浓的嘲讽。

「唉。」裴璎珞放弃地轻叹了口气，黛眉微蹙，小手端起茶杯轻啜了口。

慕容彻见她黛眉微拧，烦恼的模样别有一番风情，目光不由得停留在她脸上，毕竟人人皆爱欣赏美的事物。不可否认，裴璎珞的一颦一笑都十分引人注目。

「既然如此，璎珞也不便再打扰了。」裴璎珞起身欲告辞。

「裴姑娘打算在玄武城停留多久？」慕容彻起身送她出去。

「会暂时停留一段时间，若是慕容公子改变心意的话，可以派人到苏府去通知我。」裴璎珞仍抱着一丝希望，虽然明知希望渺茫。

慕容彻轻笑，二人并肩走过穿堂，回到铺子前。

「慕容公子，告辞了。」裴璎珞朝他弯身一福，旋身正欲走出灵凤轩。

「没想到裴姑娘也是个矫情之人，明明就不认同我的所做所为，却为了自家的利益逼迫自己和我谈生意。一慕容彻清俊的脸上笑容不变，凉凉的语调里有着明显的暗讽。

裴璎珞顿住脚步，旋身望着他，杏眸难掩惊愕。她以为自己掩饰得很好，没想到还是被他给瞧出来了。

而且还是用这种方式——直接当面揭穿她；他到底是个什么样的人？

「慕容公子言重了。璎珞毕竟只是个外人，又有何资格论断公子的所做所为呢？告辞了。」裴璎珞杏眸无惧地直视他，娇软的嗓音吐出无懈可击的话，再次朝他弯身一福，和秋月一同离开。

「不愧是珠玉阁的人。」慕容彻忍不住低低笑了起来，那笑容里有着少见的真心，令一旁的韦翰和常青讶异地互视一眼。

裴璎珞外表柔美纤细，但骨子里却是个有胆识又聪慧的女子，有意思！
content_en:
"Yingluo, I'm really glad that you can come to Xuanwu City." Shangguan Yueluo sat next to Su Kunyuan, thanking her for taking this trip to facilitate the two of them.

"What are you two planning to do next?" She wanted to hear what they were planning to do next.

"I originally planned to wait until my father's birthday has passed before bringing up the matter between me and Yue'er. My parents have always liked you, so I want you to come forward and reject me directly. I think my parents will give up now." If the two of them have no feelings for each other, it is useless for the elders to like them, and they cannot be escorted to worship.

"Okay. I will find a time to talk to Aunt Zhu." Pei Yingluo agreed.It's a simple matter. Look at Shangguan Yue with your apricot eyes."Yue'er, your parents won't object to the matter between you and Brother Su, right?"

"You also know that we, mother and daughter, have no status at all in the house. Dad is naturally happy to be able to join the Su family." Shangguan Yue smiled bitterly.

Su Kunyuan gently held her hand comfortingly, and the natural affection between the two made Pei Yingluo, who was sitting opposite, envious.

The three of them chatted for a while, and Pei Yingluo wisely left first, leaving the two of them alone.

Pei Yingluo and his servant left the inn, asked for the direction of Lingfengxuan, and walked for about a quarter of an hour.

At this moment, she was standing in front of the Lingfengxuan shop in the east of the city, looking at the plaque hanging on the door. The three characters Lingfengxuan were written in gold letters on a black background.

"Girl, do you want to come in for a visit? The crystals we sell at Lingfengxuan are all rare treasures." Chang Qing, who was wearing a green robe and with a smile on her baby face, saw the stunning beauty standing outside the door and took the initiative to step forward and ask.

"Then I'll excuse you." A slight smile appeared on Pei Yingluo's soft face.

That slight smile made Chang Qing stare straight for a moment, but Qiu Yue beside him coughed slightly in displeasure. Only then did he come back to his senses and lead the master and servant into the shop respectfully and politely.

As soon as Pei Yingluo stepped into the shop, she looked at the necklaces, bracelets, earrings, and ornaments displayed on the cabinets. They were all made of crystals of various colors. The colors were dazzling. At a glance, she knew that the quality was better than that of the Pearl and Jade Pavilion.

The Pei family owns gold and silver veins, so there is no problem in providing the gold and silver jewelry for Zhuyu Pavilion.

But when it comes to crystals, they were provided by a friend of my eldest brother who specializes in shipping goods from the north to the south. Naturally, they cannot be compared with the crystals mined on Lingshan Island.

This is why the eldest brother hopes that she can meet Murong Che and discuss the possibility of cooperation between the two companies.This was her second purpose for coming to Xuanwu City.

It's just that she never expected that Murong Che would be such a person who hides his sword behind his smile, so she... hesitated about the possibility of cooperation proposed by her eldest brother.

"I wonder if the crystal ornaments sold by Lingfengxuan are suitable for Miss Pei Er's eyes?"

Suddenly, a laughing voice came from behind, and Pei Yingluo turned around in shock, her almond-shaped eyes meeting that handsome and smiling face.

"Mr. Murong." Since you met him here, why not take this opportunity to talk to him?

"It has been heard that the hair accessories of Zhuyu Pavilion were all drawn and carved by Miss Pei herself. I wonder what Miss Pei thinks of the crystals sold by Lingfengxuan?" Murong Che smiled with his dark eyes, and did not miss the slight frown on her eyebrows when she turned to face him. It seemed that she was not happy to see him.

"Mr. Murong, you're welcome. Every crystal in Lingfeng Pavilion is clear in texture and bright in color. It's of top quality. Whether it's an amethyst necklace, a pink quartz bracelet, a topaz pendant, etc., all the accessories are stunning. How can Yingluo dare to have any opinions about it." She said these words not to be polite, but to tell the truth.

I had only heard that Lingfengxuan's crystals were of high quality, and seeing them is better than hearing it a hundred times. It's no wonder that even though it's expensive, people are still flocking to it.

It was said that the ladies in the palace especially loved Lingfengxuan's crystal jewelry, and the Queen's aunt even had a very precious amethyst necklace.

"It is a great honor for me, Lingfengxuan, to be praised by Miss Pei Er."

Murong Che stared at her soft and beautiful face with his dark eyes. He had heard that the three sisters of the Pei family were extremely beautiful. He originally thought the rumors were too exaggerated. It was not until he met Pei Liuli in the Meng Mansion and now Pei Yingluo that he believed the rumors were true.

Unlike Pei Liuli, whose beautiful face reveals shrewdness, Pei Yingluo's softness exudes a sense of spirituality and serenity, and it can be seen that she must have a good temperament.

"I don't know if Mr. Murong is free at the moment. Yingluo has something she wants to talk to Mr. Murong privately."

Murong Che raised his eyebrows in surprise, and the smile on Qing Jun's face deepened.

"Then please follow me." He took the lead and headed towards the curtain in the corner of the shop.

Upon seeing this, Pei Yingluo hurriedly followed him and saw him opening the curtain and walking straight in. After passing through the hall, he stopped in front of a wing room.

Murong Che turned back to look at her with a smile, opened the door and walked in.

Pei Yingluo hesitated for a while, and was about to follow her in, but was held back by Qiuyue.

"Second Miss, are you sure you want to go in? Although Mr. Murong always smiles, I can tell that he is not a good person." Qiuyue couldn't help but be afraid when she thought of the scene she saw in the alley of Suzaku City: she believed that it would be difficult for Second Miss to forget it.

"Although he is not a good person, he should not do anything to hurt me. Don't forget, we are here to complete the tasks assigned by the elder brother." Pei Yingluo believed that she would not misjudge the person.

When Qiuyue heard this, she stopped stopping him.She was also present when the eldest young master explained the matter to the second young lady.

"Let's go."

Pei Yingluo glanced at her and walked in first, followed quickly by Qiuyue.

Chapter 2(1)

"I don't agree."

Murong Che looked at the beautiful lady sitting opposite him with a smile, took a sip of hot tea, and rejected her proposal without any consideration.

"Mr. Murong, my brother is very sincere in wanting to cooperate with Lingfengxuan. It's easy to negotiate the price." Pei Yingluo persuaded softly.

She secretly thought that she was not good at business matters, but her elder brother asked her to come forward to negotiate this cooperation, which was really difficult for her.What's more, the man she faced was not simple. How could she possibly convince him?

The wing the two of them were staying in at the moment was the wing where Murong Che rested when she came to Lingfengxuan. In order to avoid suspicion, the door was wide open, and Qiu Yue, who was worried about her, followed behind her.

"I don't intend to share the profits of the crystals sold in Lingfengxuan. They are sold exclusively by Lingfengxuan. Your Pei family's Pearl and Jade Pavilion is already well-known in the government and the public, so why are you greedily coveting the crystals of Lingfengxuan?" Murong Che poured her a cup of hot tea, his smile filled with sarcasm.

"Oh." Pei Yingluo sighed in resignation, frowned slightly, picked up the teacup with her little hand and took a sip.

Murong Che saw that her dark eyebrows were slightly twisted, and her troubled look was very charming, so his eyes couldn't help but stay on her face. After all, everyone loves to appreciate beautiful things.It is undeniable that Pei Yingluo's every smile is very eye-catching.

"In this case, it's inconvenient for Yingluo to bother you any more." Pei Yingluo stood up to leave.

"How long do you plan to stay in Xuanwu City, Miss Pei?" Murong Che stood up and saw her out.

"I will stay temporarily for a while. If Mr. Murong changes his mind, you can send someone to the Su Mansion to inform me." Pei Yingluo still held on to a glimmer of hope, although she knew it was slim.

Murong Che chuckled, and the two walked side by side through the hall and returned to the shop.

"Mr. Murong, farewell." Pei Yingluo bent towards him and turned around to walk out of Lingfeng Pavilion.

"I didn't expect that Miss Pei was also a hypocritical person. She clearly didn't agree with what I was doing, but she forced herself to negotiate business with me for her own benefit. The smile on Murong Che's handsome face remained unchanged, and there was obvious innuendo in his cool tone.

Pei Yingluo stopped and turned to look at him, her almond-shaped eyes unable to conceal her surprise.She thought she was hiding it well, but she didn't expect him to see it out.

And still in this way - exposing her directly to her face; what kind of person is he?

"Mr. Murong's words are serious. After all, Yingluo is just an outsider, so who has the right to judge what he has done? I'm leaving." Pei Yingluo looked directly at him fearlessly with her almond-shaped eyes, spoke impeccable words in her soft voice, bent towards him again, and left with Qiuyue.

"As expected of a member of Zhuyu Pavilion." Murong Che couldn't help but laugh softly. There was a rare sincerity in that smile, which made Wei Han and Chang Qing look at each other in surprise.

Pei Yingluo looks soft and slender, but underneath she is a courageous and intelligent woman, interesting!
